## Release-safety checklist

- [ ] I kept planning read-only and backend commands as argument arrays.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for success, failure, and cleanup behavior.
- [ ] I updated schemas, examples, docs, and the changelog when public behavior changed.
- [ ] I ran formatting, clippy, tests, and package validation locally.
- [ ] I did not commit private media, secrets, machine-specific paths, or unbounded logs.
- [ ] I documented compatibility or migration impact.
